# Vendor marks

| File | What it is | Where it came from |
|---|---|---|
| `github.svg` | GitHub's mark | https://logos.lndev.me/logos/github.svg — unmodified |
| `github-dark.svg` | The same mark reversed for a dark ground | `github.svg` with its single ink value changed from `#161614` to `#f5f5f7`. Nothing else differs. |

Used beside the link that leads to the extension's releases, so it is obvious
where the download comes from before you click it.

**This is someone else's trademark.** It marks a destination, not an
endorsement, affiliation or partnership by GitHub. The collection it came from
grants no rights of its own: "All logos are trademarks of their respective
owners. Provided for convenience — check each brand's guidelines before use."
Whoever deploys this site is the party bound by those guidelines.

The agent marks in `../agents/` carry the same note.
